انبهرت (form VII)
# اِنْبَهَرْتُ (inbahartu) /in.ba.har.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْبَهَرَ (inbahara)
# اِنْبَهَرْتَ (inbaharta) /in.ba.har.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْبَهَرَ (inbahara)
# اِنْبَهَرْتِ (inbaharti) /in.ba.har.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْبَهَرَ (inbahara)
# اِنْبَهَرَتْ (inbaharat) /in.ba.ha.rat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
